extracted.name: Chocolate chia pudding
extracted.description: Make a tasty, healthy chocolate pudding in just five minutes. It's low-calorie and vegan, too, and the chia seeds are a great source of omega-3 fatty acids
ingredient_lines: 400ml unsweetened almond milk or hazelnut milk
instruction_lines: Put all the ingredients in a large bowl with a generous pinch of sea salt and whisk to combine. Cover with cling film then leave to thicken in the fridge for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Spoon the pudding into four glasses, then top with the frozen berries and cacao nibs.
